title: How to clean a fabric sofa

pieces.say: Your sofa is dirtier than it looks.
pieces.text: Your sofa is dirtier than it looks.
pieces.label: HIDDEN GRIME

pieces.say: Here's the hidden spot. The cleaning code on the label.
W or WS? Water's okay. S or X? No water.
Vacuum every seam and cushion first.
Spot-test warm water with a drop of washing-up liquid.
Then blot the mark with a cloth. Blot, don't soak.
One cleaner at a time, never mix them.
Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
